apiKey.title: Apify API Token
apiKey.description: Your Apify API token for authenticated access. Get it from https://console.apify.com/settings/integrations. Required for data retrieval; optional for server discovery and capability listing.

tools.name: crawl_website
tools.description: Crawl a website and extract structured content from all accessible pages. Returns page titles, meta descriptions, headings, body text, internal/external links, and page structure. Use for SEO audits, content inventory, site mapping, or data extraction for analysis.

max_pages.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl (default 10, higher for full site scans)

tools.name: detect_tech_stack
tools.description: Identify the technology stack and services used by a website. Returns framework names, CMS platform, JavaScript libraries, analytics services, CDN provider, hosting provider, and security tools detected. Use for competitive analysis, vendor intelligence, or understanding site architecture.

tools.name: check_dns
tools.description: Perform DNS lookup to retrieve DNS record details for a domain. Returns A records (IP addresses), MX records (mail servers), CNAME records, NS records (nameservers), and TXT records. Use for email setup verification, DNS troubleshooting, or server infrastructure research.

tools.name: check_ssl
tools.description: Inspect SSL/TLS certificate details for a domain. Returns certificate issuer, expiration date, subject alternative names (SANs), key strength, and certificate chain validation status. Use for security audits, certificate renewal tracking, or compliance verification.

tools.name: lookup_whois
tools.description: Query WHOIS database for domain registration details. Returns registrant name, registrar, registration and expiration dates, registrant contact info, and nameserver list. Use for domain research, owner identification, or tracking registration status.

domain.description: Domain name to look up in WHOIS (e.g. 'example.com', 'company.org')

resources.name: Available Analyses
resources.description: Website crawling, tech stack detection, DNS lookup, SSL inspection, and WHOIS queries.

prompts.name: site_audit
prompts.description: Perform a comprehensive SEO and technical audit of a website including content, tech stack, DNS, SSL, and WHOIS.
